raw_text: NEW IMAGERY: Planet Labs captures from 21 Jan show unusual activity at Pakistan SSG training facility near Kotli, PoK. Multiple temporary structures erected, vehicle tracks consistent with battalion-level exercise. Facility is only 12km from LoC. Forwarding coordinates to defence analysts for verification.
